why: An oath roll ('The following Member took and subscribed the Oath of Allegiance:' and the member's name) was credited to Mdm Speaker.
title: Administration of Oath
html:
Mdm Speaker: Order. Oath of Allegiance. The hon Member, present to take his seat, will please come forward when his name is called.

[(proc text) The following Member took and subscribed the Oath of Allegiance: (proc text)]

[(proc text) Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok) (proc text)]

Mdm Speaker: Order. Questions for Oral Answer.
